an3.118:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti …pe… samphappalāpī hoti.
an3.118:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti vyāpannacitto hoti.
an3.118:4.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano :
an3.118:4.3: natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ …pe… natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti.
an3.118:4.5: sīlavipattihetu vā bhikkhave sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. cittavipattihetu vā bhikkhave sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. diṭṭhivipattihetu vā bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
an3.118:4.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṃ khitto yena yeneva patiṭṭhāti, suppatiṭṭhitaññeva patiṭṭhāti.
an3.118:4.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, sīlavipattihetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. cittavipattihetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. diṭṭhivipattihetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
an3.118:6.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
an3.118:7.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti, avyāpannacitto hoti.
an3.118:8.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano :
an3.118:8.3: atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ …pe… atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti.
an3.118:8.5: sīlasampadāhetu vā bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. cittasampadāhetu vā bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
an3.118:8.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṃ khitto yena yeneva patiṭṭhāti, suppatiṭṭhitaññeva patiṭṭhāti.
an3.118:8.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, sīlasampadāhetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. cittasampadāhetu vā …pe… diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
